data.name: The Book of Yog:Premium Edition
data.detailed_description:
1. A feature-packed buy-to-play idle game with a massive roster of unique heroes — summon freely and build your dream team, like a premium gacha simulator without the paywall.

2. Built around the joy of growth and collecting — all it costs is electricity, not your life.

3. Free Trading — freely exchange items and rare equipment with other players. We will continue refining the trading system to foster a healthy game ecosystem.

4. Fair and Free — standing out among countless players comes down purely to your game knowledge and luck. The only thing we can do is: "Good luck."

5. Build Crafting — your team composition influences your main hero's skill build. Combine specific equipment and freely allocated talents to create bizarre yet devastating off-meta builds. If you can dream it, you can build it!

6. Rich Loot System — hundreds of randomly generated unique pieces of loot across Equipment, Gems, Relics, and Runes. Every battle brings unexpected rewards and experiences!

7. A Tale of Tears and Laughter — witness the growth of the characters and the budding of affection. What awaits you is a story of saving the world, set against a landscape of shifting winds and tides.

8. Season Mode — a new themed season launches every 3–6 months, each bringing fresh content, a fresh start, exclusive season rewards, and seasonal events, ensuring the game always feels brand new.

9. Long-Term Updates — more and richer content will continue to roll out with each season update. Stay tuned!
